name: Private Party Coffee Cart

heroImage.alt: Coffee being prepared on the Sip Social cart at a private event

intro: Birthdays, christenings, garden parties and family celebrations — proper coffee for your guests, without you lifting a finger.
body: Not every party needs a full bar, but most benefit from good coffee somewhere in the day — for the designated drivers, for anyone who needs to perk up before a long afternoon, or simply because it's a nicer thing to offer guests than instant from a flask.
We set up, serve, and clear down, so hosting the party doesn't mean also running a drinks station.
highlights: Ideal for garden parties, birthdays and family celebrations
You host — we handle the coffee
Scales from a small gathering to a large garden party

faqs.q: What's the smallest event you'll cater?
faqs.a: Get in touch with your guest numbers and we'll let you know what works — there's no fixed minimum, but very small gatherings may suit a different package than a large one.

faqs.q: Do you need access to a kitchen or power supply?
faqs.a: The cart is fully self-contained for most set-ups, but access to power is helpful. Tell us about your location when you enquire and we'll confirm what's needed.
